About Phase2 Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force . In pursuit of digital experience that advances the human experience, you will do your best work, live fully, and succeed as a team.

Phase2 a digital agency passionate about customer experience, grounded in data & insights, and rooted in more than two decades of successful technology delivery. We guide industry-leading companies to what’s next in their digital slandscape. And it all begins with finding the right people who align with our values and passion for impact.

About the Role Phase2 is seeking a Senior Project Manager to own complex digital engagements and lead trusted, senior-level client relationships. Project managers often focus on the triple constraint of scope, time, and cost, but Phase2 is seeking a different breed of PM who can think beyond constraints.

Project Managers at Phase2 create a unique, engaging, and impactful client experience with long-term outcomes. They bring a future-focused perspective, anticipate client needs, and ensure decisions and direction align with what will drive meaningful progress and outcomes.

They bring clarity to ambiguity, guide clients through key decisions, and keep work moving forward, ensuring clients feel confident, supported, and satisfied.

This position reports to: VP, Project Management Compensation: Base annual salary of $120,000 - $155,000 What You’ll Do Own multi-workstream engagements end-to-end, ensuring delivery stays aligned with client goals, expected outcomes, and organizational standards.

Set direction by translating client objectives into structured plans, decision frameworks, and actionable priorities. Drive outcomes and client value with an emphasis on rapid time to value, using practical delivery discipline and AI-enabled approaches to accelerate insight, execution, and impact.

Lead the client relationship with confidence and clarity, ensuring expectations are understood, risks and mitigations are discussed early, and decisions continue moving forward. Direct cross-functional teams by establishing clear and outcome-aligned workflows, communication patterns, and accountability across all contributors.

Take ownership of engagement financials, including scope, forecasting, staffing, and margin performance, adjusting plans as conditions shift. Own and evolve the engagement roadmap and delivery approach ensuring work is sequenced to drive momentum, demonstrate value early, and unlock what’s next.

Embed AI tools into engagement workflows to strengthen planning, insight generation, communication, and decision support—setting expectations for how teams use AI to improve clarity, efficiency, and quality of work. Provide grounded recommendations that help clients evaluate tradeoffs, understand implications, and make informed decisions.

Identify risks early, lead mitigation efforts, and ensure issues are resolved with clarity and speed. Recognize and shape opportunities that arise naturally from delivery insight, client context, or emerging needs. Support the creation of proposals, estimates, and scopes that reflect realistic delivery plans and forward-looking client priorities.

What You’ll Need Significant experience owning complex digital engagements and leading senior client relationships. A strong instinct for bringing order to complexity—setting direction, aligning teams, and maintaining steady progress across multiple workstreams.

Demonstrated ability to solve problems creatively and constructively, balancing constraints across scope, budget, timelines, and team capacity without compromising outcomes. Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to lead client discussions, present recommendations, and guide decisions.

Deep understanding of digital platforms, product development lifecycles, and modern delivery practices. Demonstrated ability to embed AI in daily workflows and deliverables—using it to accelerate analysis, sharpen communication, synthesize information, and elevate the overall quality of engagement leadership.

Experience guiding teams in responsible, effective AI use, ensuring it enhances outcomes, improves speed and structure, and supports stronger decision-making. A track record of identifying meaningful opportunities rooted in client strategy, delivery insight, or future potential. Agency or consultancy experience preferred.

What Success Looks Like Clients feel led, supported, and confident in both the direction and decisions of the engagement. Teams operate with clarity, alignment, and consistent direction, even as priorities evolve. Engagements maintain predictable delivery, proactive risk management, and stable momentum.

Decisions are shaped with context, structure, and clear implications, enabling clients to move forward confidently. Clients feel energized and inspired by the clarity, momentum, and possibilities the partnership creates. New opportunities emerge naturally because the work is thoughtful, high-performing, and forward-looking.

Engagements meet expectations across delivery quality, relationship strength, and commercial performance. What You’ll Get The chance to make a real impact in the health and wellness space, helping millions of people per year. To work from wherever you thrive best. We’re a remote-first team built on trust, flexibility, and outcomes.

A competitive compensation package that considers various factors. A comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, and supplemental insurance. Our fun and interactive wellness program offers rewards for participation.

A 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution–no match required and 100% vested after just 90 days. You’ll start with 16 paid vacation days, 4 personal days, and 1 volunteer day each year. Vacation and personal time increase with your tenure, recognizing your continued contributions.

Up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents and up to 6 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, based on your tenure. This includes support for adoption and foster placement, along with the option to extend time off through additional unpaid leave.

Inclusive fertility, adoption, and surrogacy benefits through Kindbody, along with virtual health coaching and care navigation. A $500 stipend to personalize and equip your home workspace for success. What the Environment Looks Like Physical Demands Frequently remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time.

Occasional adjusting or moving of light objects up to 20 pounds in all directions. Continuous communication on live video chats, calls, and through emails and messaging platforms for the purpose of exchanging information. Continuous repetitive movements that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Travel, sometimes frequent, is expected.

Mental Demands Comprehension - Must continuously be able to understand direction and adhere to established procedures. Must also be able to gather information from clients and employees and synthesize this information in a meaningful way. May also be responsible for making improvements or recommendations to existing procedures.

Organization - Must continuously be able to gather and classify information, store information learned from conversations and communications, and then be and be able to quickly recall, interpret, and explain information. Reasoning and Decision Making - Must continuously use logic to analyze and interpret information, and prioritize.

Communication - Must continuously express or exchange ideas and meaning with employees and clients. Resilience - Must continuously adapt well in the face of workplace stressors. Technical Project Manager Are you a highly organized Technical Project Manager ready to take the next step in your career? Do you enjoy working in fast-paced environments where you can create structure, align engineering and business teams, and drive technical initiatives that make a measurable impact?

If so, Codekeeper could be the right place for you. We are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who takes ownership and actively contributes to the successful planning, coordination, and execution of technical projects across teams.

Our ideal candidate is eager to grow within the industry, comfortable working at the intersection of engineering and operations, and ready to roll up their sleeves to ensure projects are delivered on time and to the highest standard. If you're driven, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering results, we'd love to hear from you.

We're accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit - so we encourage early applications. Role Description As a Technical Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing technical projects and ensuring they are successfully delivered with strong results and real impact.

Your work will include planning, coordinating, researching, organizing, and driving projects that bridge engineering, product, and business goals.

Thriving in our dynamic, fast-paced environment requires not only monitoring progress but actively engaging in every stage of the project lifecycle—from initial scoping through execution and continuous improvement.

Within our fast-moving environment, there is always something happening, offering plenty of opportunities to step in, take ownership, and make a meaningful contribution. Key Responsibilities

Innovate and Navigate: Lead technical projects from inception to completion, breathing life into project ideas with your structured planning and pragmatic execution. Transform technical requirements into tangible successes, leveraging your unique blend of technical understanding and analytical skills.

Guide and Achieve: Monitor the heartbeat of project progress with an eagle eye, setting ambitious yet attainable deadlines. Your leadership will ensure projects not only stay on track but also sprint toward their goals, exceeding expectations.

Communicate and Collaborate: Act as the pivotal bridge between engineering teams and department heads, translating technical detail into clear business language. Your adept communication skills will foster an environment of clarity and cooperation, driving collective success.

Resolve and Propel: Embrace technical and organizational challenges with a problem-solving mindset, navigating through obstacles with agility. Your capacity to identify solutions and make decisive actions will keep projects advancing, even against the odds.

Deliver Excellence: Cross the finish line with projects that not only meet the brief but also set new standards of excellence. Your commitment to quality and results will not just complete tasks but will carve out new benchmarks for success.

AmeriSave Mortgage Corp. has set the standard in online mortgage lending, with over $130 billion in funded loan volume. As one of the top rated, largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the nation, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication and excellence.

We leverage cutting edge technology and data driven strategies to provide exceptional service to our customers. Our employees are the driving force behind our success. We believe in the power of a dynamic and talented workforce and creating an environment where your contributions are not just recognized, they're celebrated.

Your success is our success, and we are seeking skilled professionals who are ready to bring their A-game, exceed benchmarks, and enhance the overall excellence of AmeriSave, while also growing and advancing their careers. At AmeriSave, we're one team with one shared dream: to be the best. Let's redefine excellence together!

What We’re Looking For: AmeriSave is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our Enterprise Technology & AI organization. This role sits at the intersection of technology and the business, driving complex, cross-functional initiatives that span in-house built systems, operational process change, and executive-level strategic priorities.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who has led both technology projects and business initiatives end to end, ideally within a well-known mortgage lending organization, and who is equally comfortable in a Gantt chart, a stakeholder steering committee, or a working session with engineers reviewing a build.

You will be the connective tissue between technology, operations, and leadership, translating strategy into executable plans and keeping delivery honest with data.

What You'll Do: End-to-End Project Ownership: Own the full lifecycle of complex, cross-functional projects, from charter and requirements through execution, go-live, and post-launch measurement, spanning both technology builds and business/operational initiatives.

In-House Technology Delivery: Manage delivery of technology projects built in-house by internal engineering teams, partnering closely with product, engineering, and QA to sequence work, manage dependencies, and de-risk timelines for custom-built platforms and tools.

Planning & Tooling: Build and maintain detailed project plans, roadmaps, and Gantt charts using modern project management tooling; track milestones, critical path, resourcing, and risk in a way that is transparent to both delivery teams and executives.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead project teams composed of stakeholders across Technology, Operations, Capital Markets, Compliance, and Customer Service; align competing priorities, resolve blockers, and drive decisions to closure across departmental lines.

Executive Communication: Prepare and deliver clear, concise, and data-backed status updates, business cases, and executive readouts; comfortably present progress, risks, and trade-offs directly to senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders.

Analytical Rigor: Use data to drive decisions: define success metrics up front, build reporting/dashboards to track project and post-launch performance, and use quantitative analysis to identify risk, scope creep, or underperformance early.

Process Improvement: Identify process gaps and inefficiencies across the project portfolio and drive continuous improvement in how the organization plans, prioritizes, and delivers work.

Risk Management: Proactively surface, document, and manage project risks and issues, escalating appropriately and driving mitigation plans to protect timelines and business outcomes.

What You’ll Need: Deep Industry Experience: 7+ years of project management experience leading both technology and business initiatives, preferably within the mortgage industry, and preferably with a well-known mortgage lender or financial services company.

Technology & Business Project Management: Demonstrated success managing technology projects built in-house (custom platforms, internal tools, proprietary systems) in close partnership with engineering teams, in addition to managing business/operational projects.

Tools & Planning: Advanced proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, Asana, or similar) and hands-on skill building and maintaining Gantt charts, roadmaps, and resourcing plans.

Cross-Functional Project Management: Proven track record managing initiatives across multiple departments and stakeholder groups, building consensus and driving alignment among teams with competing priorities.

Executive Communication: Polished, confident communicator who can distill complex, technical, or ambiguous initiatives into clear narratives for executive audiences, both in writing and in live presentations.

Analytical Mindset: Comfortable working with data to define KPIs, build simple dashboards or reporting views, and use metrics (not just status colors) to tell the true story of a project's health. Certifications: PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification a plus; experience with Agile/Scrum delivery models is a requirement.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or a related field; MBA a plus. High-speed internet required for remote work, Cable or Fiber ONLY with the ability to connect via Ethernet.

The CSP and Medication Safety Program Manager is a licensed pharmacist responsible for the development, implementation, management, and reporting outcomes of the CSP and Medication Safety Program.

The Program Manager directs, oversees, and supervises activities of all assigned operational, technical and professional personnel, and is the leader for assuring that all USP795, USP797 and USP800 CSP compliance requirements are met in the Sterile Processing and Hazardous Drug Management arenas.

Maintenance of all required processes and documentation for completely meeting USP795, USP797, and USP800 are a primary focus of this position.

They will develop and implement appropriate procedures, oversees and assures facility compliance with USP795, USP797, and USP800 and other applicable laws, regulations, and standards, ensuring competency of personnel, and assuring environmental control of all compounding areas.

CSP Program Management Ensures CSP and hazardous medications are handled and prepared in accordance with all departmental policies/procedures and all State, Federal, and other governing body laws and regulations including VAPSHCS policy, VHA Directives, FDA and DEA regulations, Federal and State Law, NIOSH, USP and TJC standards.

Establishes CSP Committee as required to meet the VHA directive related to compounded sterile preparations. Maintains the CSP and Hazardous Medication program to improve outcomes of patients and to protect healthcare workers.

Ensures the facility hazardous medication policy is reviewed yearly, staff are educated on each new hazardous medication introduced into the workplace and is responsible for annual hazardous medication training of all relevant staff.

Participates in continuous quality initiatives to assist with the continual improvement of procedures, policies, and overall performance of the program. Maintains a compounded sterile preparation and hazardous medication quality assurance plan in collaboration with Quality Management and Infection Prevention.

Identifies outcome measures to evaluate success of the program and identify opportunities for improvement or expansion.

Collaborates with additional services including Facilities Management Service, Industrial Hygiene, Infection Prevention and Environmental Management Services, and provides quarterly reports detailing results of any investigations and corrective actions due to failures in microbial monitoring parameters or engineering controls to the Medical Executive Committee and Pentad through the facility VA CSP Advisory Committee.

Maintains clinical oversight of patients receiving compounded sterile and hazardous medications to ensure safe and effective utilization. Promotes Pharmacy Clinical Services philosophy of multidisciplinary teamwork and customer service and to make patient-focused decisions.

Encourages pharmacy activities that support the pharmacy mission using established goals and objectives to make critical decisions. Collaborates with other pharmacy program managers and supervisors to integrate the Compounded Sterile Preparations and Hazardous Medication Program into the global mission of the department. s.

Medication Safety Program Management: Participates as the Pharmacy Clinical (PCS) service line representative for the patient safety committee Reviews and assesses compliance with VHA Handbooks, USP 797 Standards, and EPA regulations and any other accreditation surveys or inspections (e.g. OIG, TJC, CARF, and OSHA).

Develops and implements policies as needed to ensure compliance. Monitors and reviews medication errors. Reviews data for trends and when systems errors occur, works to correct processes. Actively conducts surveillance of all adverse drug events reported through the VA ADERS reporting program and Adverse Reaction Tracking System.

Surveillance may be performed through screening for abnormal lab values, discharge diagnosis, and use of antidotes. Assists in the quality assurance process for IV infusion smart pumps. Assists in the evaluation process of cabinet based dispensing system (e.g. Omnicell) overrides.

Serves as the pharmacy technical expert on committees and task forces that relate to medication safety (e.g. Root Cause Analysis, Focused Review, and Process Action Team) Work Schedule: Monday through Friday 7:00 am - 3:30 pm Telework: Ad hoc only Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Dans cette fonction, vous jouez un rôle central dans le passage des projets de développement à la production série. Vous définissez les process de fabrication pour les projets d'industrialisation en vous assurant de leur conformité avec les standards internes, les exigences qualité et les objectifs de performance attendus.
Vous analysez les besoins de production, les contraintes techniques ainsi que les flux de fabrication afin de proposer des méthodes industrielles robustes, fiables et adaptées à l'environnement horloger. Vous participez à la sélection des moyens de production, à la formalisation des gammes opératoires et à la mise en place des paramètres nécessaires au bon déroulement des opérations.
Vous êtes également responsable de l'estimation des temps de fabrication et de la validation de la performance des process en termes de prix, de qualité et de délai. À ce titre, vous contribuez à sécuriser les objectifs industriels et à anticiper les éventuels écarts de performance.
Vous suivez les phases de présérie afin de vous assurer du bon fonctionnement des process définis, de leur stabilité et de leur robustesse en conditions réelles de production. Vous identifiez les axes d'amélioration, pilotez les ajustements nécessaires et coordonnez les actions correctives avec les différents interlocuteurs concernés.
En parallèle, vous animez et coordonnez les équipes impliquées tout au long de la phase de production. Vous veillez à la bonne circulation des informations, à la priorisation des actions et au suivi rigoureux des rectifications à mettre en œuvre. Vous jouez un véritable rôle de liaison entre les équipes techniques, la production, la qualité et les autres services partenaires.
Par votre implication, vous garantissez la cohérence industrielle des projets confiés, tout en assurant un accompagnement structuré jusqu'à la mise en production optimale.

Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation de Technicien ET ou d'un titre jugé équivalent. Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans une fonction similaire, idéalement en tant que chef de projets industrialisation, au sein d'un environnement industriel exigeant.
Vous possédez de très bonnes connaissances de la fabrication et des produits mécaniques horlogers. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés à l'industrialisation, à l'optimisation des processus, à l'analyse des temps de production et au suivi de performance. Une bonne compréhension des problématiques qualité, coûts et délais constitue un atout essentiel pour réussir dans cette fonction.
Vous êtes reconnu pour votre esprit d'initiative, votre sens de l'organisation et votre rigueur. Vous savez gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle, structurer vos priorités et avancer avec méthode dans un environnement où la précision est primordiale.

Project Name: Digital Shared Services
Position: Project Manager
Engagement: Full-Time – One Individual Resource
Work Arrangement: Remote, Canada only
Sector: Digital Health / Healthcare Technology
Location: Remote access; services must be performed from within Canada

Digital Health, a Shared Health service, is focused on improving and enabling healthcare delivery transformation through the effective use of information and communication technology. The Digital Shared Services initiative supports the delivery of efficient, effective information management and technology processes across Manitoba's provincial health sector.
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with a strong background in healthcare technology, enterprise transformation, program delivery, and senior stakeholder management. The successful candidate will lead complex technology and business transformation initiatives involving multidisciplinary teams, technology vendors, clinical stakeholders, executive leadership, and public-sector partners.
The Project Manager will provide strategic and operational leadership across the project lifecycle, including planning, governance, budgeting, resource management, risk management, procurement, implementation, and transition to operations.

Project and Program Leadership
Lead complex technology, business, and process transformation initiatives from project initiation through implementation and transition.
Develop project charters, business cases, project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, governance structures, and implementation strategies.
Establish and maintain project governance, including steering committees, working groups, decision-making processes, and escalation mechanisms.
Manage project scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and constraints.
Establish appropriate project controls and reporting mechanisms to monitor performance and communicate project status.
Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and interdependencies across technology, business, clinical, and operational teams.
Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with organizational standards, policies, objectives, and governance requirements.
Senior Management & Team Leadership
Provide leadership and performance management accountability for direct reports and multidisciplinary project teams.
Establish clear objectives, accountabilities, performance expectations, and delivery priorities for team members.
Coordinate internal resources, external consultants, technology vendors, business stakeholders, and healthcare professionals.
Foster a collaborative and accountable team environment focused on successful project outcomes.
Identify resource requirements and optimize resource allocation throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage team performance, resolve conflicts, and address issues that may impact delivery.
Budget & Resource Management
Develop project and program budgets in collaboration with finance, business, and executive stakeholders.
Monitor project expenditures, forecasts, commitments, and financial performance.
Track costs against approved budgets and identify variances and corrective actions.
Manage resource assignments and capacity planning.
Ensure appropriate financial and resource controls are established and maintained.
Manage vendor and contractual deliverables where applicable.
Salesforce CRM Implementation
Lead and/or manage implementation initiatives involving the Salesforce CRM platform .
Coordinate Salesforce implementation activities across business, technical, integration, data, security, testing, and operational teams.
Manage requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, training, deployment, and transition activities.
Work with business stakeholders to align Salesforce capabilities with organizational processes and strategic objectives.
Manage implementation risks, dependencies, change impacts, and adoption activities.
IT Service Management (ITSM)
Lead or support the implementation of Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) systems and practices within a healthcare environment.
Coordinate ITSM process development and implementation across service management, technical, operational, and business teams.
Support the implementation and adoption of processes such as incident management, problem management, change management, request fulfillment, configuration management, and service reporting.
Ensure ITSM initiatives align with healthcare operational requirements and organizational service delivery objectives.
Coordinate stakeholder engagement, training, process adoption, testing, and transition to operational support.
Procurement & RFP Management
Lead the development and evaluation of Requests for Proposals (RFPs) for the selection of new IT solutions.
Develop procurement strategies, requirements, evaluation criteria, scoring methodologies, and supporting documentation.
Coordinate subject matter experts and stakeholders during RFP development and evaluation.
Facilitate vendor demonstrations, clarification processes, evaluations, negotiations, and recommendations.
Ensure procurement activities are transparent, objective, well documented, and aligned with applicable public-sector requirements.
Altera Sunrise Implementation
Lead or support implementation of the Altera Sunrise suite of products within an acute care healthcare environment.
Coordinate clinical, business, technical, vendor, and operational stakeholders throughout implementation.
Manage implementation planning, requirements, configuration, integration, testing, training, readiness, deployment, and stabilization.
Ensure implementation activities support clinical workflows, operational requirements, patient-care objectives, and organizational priorities.
Coordinate issue resolution and transition to operational support.
Executive & Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as a senior point of contact for executive leadership, project sponsors, clinical leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and external partners.
Prepare and deliver executive-level presentations, project status reports, recommendations, decision papers, and briefing materials.
Communicate complex technical and business information clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
Develop effective communication and stakeholder engagement strategies.
Facilitate negotiations between stakeholders with competing priorities and objectives.
Build consensus and secure executive-level decisions and support.
Anticipate stakeholder concerns and proactively address communication and engagement needs.
Risk & Governance Management
Establish and maintain comprehensive risk and issue management processes.
Identify strategic, operational, technical, financial, clinical, and organizational risks.
Develop mitigation and contingency strategies and monitor their effectiveness.
Escalate significant risks and issues through appropriate governance channels.
Maintain project decision logs, action registers, dependency registers, and governance documentation.

## Company Description ##
**About Syngenta**
At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges.

We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact.

Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. **Syngenta has been ranked as a-top employer-by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.**
## Job Description ##
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, we are seeking a **Global Environmental Technology Lead**. This is a hybrid role based primarily in Muttenz, Switzerland, though Monthey can also be considered.
As Global Environmental Technology Lead, you will shape how Production & Supply identifies, develops and deploys the technologies that reduce environmental impact while protecting operational performance and our license to operate.

This is a high-impact global role for an accomplished scientist or engineer who can move confidently between technical depth, strategic direction and practical implementation. You will connect manufacturing sites, process development, environmental specialists and external partners to turn complex environmental challenges into scalable solutions.

* Set the global environmental technology strategy across waste, wastewater, air emissions, vent treatment, recovery and recycling, informed by Best Available Techniques (BAT).
* Identify, assess and mature emerging technologies, taking opportunities from laboratory and pilot-scale evidence through to robust manufacturing application.
* Partner with global and local manufacturing teams to solve critical environmental challenges, improve site performance and safeguard license to operate.
* Provide technical leadership and independent challenge for environmental projects, assessing feasibility, environmental benefit, risk, operability and cost.
* Influence product and process choices early by evaluating waste streams, especially wastewater, during active-ingredient process development.
* Develop practical, high-value solutions that reduce impacts to air, water and land across existing products and manufacturing sites.
* Build and lead a connected global environmental technology community spanning Technology & Engineering, Production & Supply, Environmental Managers, process development teams and external experts.
* Grow internal capabilities through technical coaching, knowledge exchange, training, literature reviews and partnerships with suppliers, consultants and technology providers.
* Translate complex environmental science and regulation into clear choices and decisive action for technical and business stakeholders.

* Master-s degree, or equivalent, in Chemistry, Chemical Process Engineering or a related discipline.
* Ideally 10+ years- experience in industrial chemical operations and/or process development.
* Demonstrated expertise in environmental technologies and a practical understanding of environmental legislation.
* Able to remain focused, resilient and effective in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Strong knowledge of waste, wastewater, emissions, recovery and recycling technologies.
* Solid grounding in organic and inorganic chemistry, chemical processes and process engineering; agrochemical production knowledge is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of environmental toxicity, chemical bio-transformation and environmental risk assessment.
* Proven ability to lead teams or workstreams in project, departmental or matrix environments.
* Experience in project and change management, with resilience in ambiguous environments.
* Strong analytical, conceptual, organisational and negotiation skills.
* Clear communication and stakeholder-influencing skills at all levels.
* Experience working across multicultural, multinational teams, with a recognised record of technical delivery.
* Fluent business English; French is highly advantageous.

* The opportunity to make a difference to process safety, both within Syngenta-s global operations, and in shaping safety legislation and culture worldwide
* A super working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
* The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
* Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options

Für unseren Kunden, ein schweizweit tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich moderner Filial- und Retaillösungen, suchen wir motivierte und handwerklich geschickte Mitarbeitende für abwechslungsreiche Montageeinsätze. Dich erwarten spannende Projekte in der ganzen Schweiz, bezahlte Fahrzeiten sowie ein eingespieltes Team, das gemeinsam Filialen mit modernen Verkaufssystemen ausstattet.
## Stellenbeschreibung ##
### Das erwartet dich im Job ###
* Kontrollieren der installierten Verkaufs-, Träger- und digitalen Preissysteme
* Planen und Koordinieren der Montageeinsätze von der Vorbereitung bis zum Projektabschluss
* Führen und Anleiten des Montageteams während der Einsätze vor Ort

### Womit du überzeugst ###

* Gute Excel-Anwenderkenntnisse und ein sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Arbeitsmitteln
* Führerausweis der Kategorie B sowie ein eigenes Fahrzeug mit genügend Stauraum
* Wohnort im Umkreis von maximal rund 20 Minuten von Gossau SG

* Einwandfreier Leumund
### Darauf kannst du dich freuen ###
* Befristete Anstellung für 4 bis 6 Monate, je nach Projektverlauf
* Verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit viel Eigenständigkeit und direkter Führung eines kleinen Montageteams
* Bezahlte Fahrzeit zu den jeweiligen Einsatzorten

Notre priorité est d-assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d-un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.
### Description du poste ###
Dans le cadre d-un projet stratégique de modernisation d-un système d-information au sein d-une organisation publique vaudoise, nous recherchons un **Chef de projet métier expérimenté H/F**.
Vous participerez à un programme de transformation visant à moderniser un système d-information dédié au traitement, à l-analyse et à la diffusion de données.

Le projet comprend notamment le déploiement d-une nouvelle solution d-analyse statistique, la migration des traitements existants, l-évolution des capacités de collecte et de stockage des données ainsi que la modernisation des outils de diffusion numérique.

Vous exercerez un rôle central d-interface entre les équipes métiers, les équipes IT et les instances de gouvernance du projet.
**Votre mission**
En collaboration étroite avec le Chef de projet IT, vous prenez en charge le pilotage du projet sur son **volet métier**, avec une attention particulière portée à la migration des traitements existants vers la nouvelle plateforme.

s.h: À ce titre, vos principales responsabilités seront de
s.t:
* conduire le projet dans le respect des processus, standards méthodologiques et objectifs définis
* organiser, planifier et coordonner les différentes phases du projet
* construire, mobiliser et accompagner les équipes métiers participant au projet
* assurer la coordination et l-alignement entre les équipes métiers et les équipes IT
* recueillir, structurer et prioriser les besoins des utilisateurs selon leur valeur métier et leur complexité
* contribuer à la définition des besoins, spécifications, tests et processus de réception des solutions
* piloter le reporting auprès de la Direction et des instances de gouvernance
* contribuer au suivi budgétaire du projet et à la gestion des engagements
* coordonner les relations avec les fournisseurs concernés
* garantir le respect des standards méthodologiques, des directives et de la stratégie définie
* participer à la réception des solutions et au retour d-expérience.
**Pilotage de la migration**
La migration constitue un volet majeur de la mission.

* concevoir et opérationnaliser le processus de migration
* établir les priorités et planifier les différentes migrations
* préparer et coordonner les équipes métiers mobilisées
* piloter plusieurs équipes et plusieurs migrations en parallèle
* garantir la disponibilité des ressources nécessaires afin de respecter le planning
* maintenir une coordination étroite avec le pilotage IT tout au long du processus.
**Conduite du changement**
Vous participerez également activement à l-accompagnement du changement induit par la transformation du système d-information.

* à l-élaboration et à la mise en œuvre du plan de communication
* à la préparation et à la coordination des actions de formation
* à l-accompagnement des équipes dans l-évolution de leurs outils et pratiques
* aux actions de conduite du changement nécessaires à l-adoption des nouvelles solutions.

* d-un **diplôme universitaire de niveau Master ou équivalent**
* d-au minimum **5 années d-expérience en tant que Chef·fe de projet**
* d-une excellente maîtrise du **français, à l-oral comme à l-écrit**
* d-une bonne maîtrise de l-**anglais technique**.
Une certification en gestion de projet ainsi qu-une formation complémentaire en conduite d-équipe constituent des atouts.

* solides compétences en gestion de projet
* capacité à collaborer avec des équipes et profils complémentaires
* orientation solutions et capacité à proposer des approches pragmatiques
* aptitude à structurer et mettre en œuvre un plan de communication
* excellente capacité de synthèse
* leadership et capacité à mobiliser les équipes
* aisance dans des environnements complexes comportant de multiples parties prenantes.
Une connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet telles que **HERMES** constitue un avantage dans le contexte de la mission.
**Expériences particulièrement appréciées**

**Conditions**
